title: [HIGH S5] Replace per-worker in-memory API key store with shared backend
acceptance_criteria: APIKeyStore can be backed by SQLite (default) with optional Redis backend
Same key created in one gunicorn worker is visible from another worker (verified by a 2-worker smoke test)
Old in-memory store still works as a fallback if no DB URL is configured (with a warning log)
Public API of APIKeyStore (create_key, validate_key, revoke_key, get_by_id) unchanged
Thread-safety: SQLite uses check_same_thread=False + connection-per-request or WAL mode
Dependencies added: aiosqlite (or sqlite3 stdlib) and optional redis
deliverables: tests/test_backend.py (add 2-worker smoke test or document manual verification)
completion_summary: Pluggable backend: memory (default), SQLite (WAL+lock, stdlib), Redis (lazy import). 15 new tests. 1114 total pass.
